diagnostic.title: System diagnostic
diagnostic.subtitle: Run an aggregated self-test against the database, MQTT broker, Redis, Tesla API, and resilience monitors. Use this when telemetry is missing, charge sessions don't appear, or notifications stop firing.
diagnostic.noReport: No diagnostic has been run in this session yet. Click "Run diagnostic" to probe every dependency.
diagnostic.errorBody: The diagnostic endpoint returned an error. Check API logs and try again.
diagnostic.copyReportError: Could not copy to clipboard. Use download instead.

brief.description: Probe outcomes and recorded timings from the displayed diagnostic report.
brief.scope: One diagnostic run; total time is the sum of probe durations.
